'''Docking Bay 3''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] located at the [[Betha II Starport]]. During the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the docking bay was used by the [[Restored Empire|Kaarenth Dissension]].
